blocks.text: At 37, Enchong Dee’s life looks very different from when the audience first met him as a young actor and former national swimmer. Over the years, that life has expanded far beyond entertainment. He has built businesses, explored investments, pursued new interests, and continued to challenge himself in different ways. Yet behind the many roles he has taken is a mindset that has remained remarkably consistent: prepare for what’s next. It is a lesson he learned early in his career and one that continues to shape how he approaches his health, finances, and future today. It is also what makes his partnership with Sun Life […]...
